mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 49 degrees near the Verona Public Library under a Third Quarter moon, and we are expecting an overnight low of 45 degrees with no rain.

October is here, and Mayor Diaz has proclaimed it Community Planning Month, highlighting the dedication of our local planning professionals. Also, remember that the Fireman's Park Beach is now closed for the season.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market or more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a notable call from September 21, local officers identified and cited a suspect for the retail theft of candy from a business on East Verona Avenue.
Today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The shop is currently open, but please note they are closing in 13 minutes, so plan your visit accordingly.
